text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
The "strongest" rocks, doesn't it?!
I mean, if you're gonna run, you gotta take the top spot!
choice_data_list: The triple-scoop cone girl...! You go to school here?!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Have we met somewhere?
Wait, forget that—tell me about that "ultimate secret weapon" stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was just talking about explosive acceleration. Having legs that can really
surge forward at the critical moment is a vital element and weapon in racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that advice was tailored to the way that girl ran.
Triple-scoop girl here must have a completely different weapon of her own.

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
My weapon... My weapon, huh...?
Ha-ha! Now this is getting interestin'! Hey, Trainer, figure mine out too!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah, so ya can't tell without seein' me run, right?
Guess it's time for a quick lap then!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Jungle Pocket!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ora ora ora oraaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her stride has the sheer power to handle any track condition, and with
her solid stamina, she looks capable of sustaining a fierce late kick.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, how's that?!
Did ya come up with somethin'?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There seem to be plenty of ways to leverage her natural gifts!
I open my laptop to pull up some coaching reference materials—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"And Fuji Kiseki surges through the inside! Fuji Kiseki on the rail!
Pushing forward from the inside lane!"
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry! That was from a video I watched this morning...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa!!
Whoa, whoa, whoa, that's Fuji-san, ain't it?!?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Man, she's so freakin' COOL!!!!
choice_data_list: ...Are you a fan of hers too?
...Are you a fan of hers too?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah I am!!
Fuji-san is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She ain't just strong, and she don't just win.
She puts on a mind-blowin' performance that totally floors everyone watchin'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take this race in the video. Her dominance went way beyond the winning margin...
She read her closing rival's moves perfectly and shut her down!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, exactly!! That's what makes Fuji-san so unstoppable!
Ha-ha, you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You totally get it, don'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, Jungle Pocket and I were sharing a firm, enthusiastic handshake.
And from that day on...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
There you are! You headin' home already?
Let's go hang out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm starvin'—family restaurant first.
Oh, heard they got darts at that net cafe by the station. Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I had officially been deemed her "pal."
And today, just like every other day, I was dragged along for the ride.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
These guys are my homies. We pretty much just chill whenever,
so make yourself at home, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Gang
text_block_list.text:
'Sup.
Nice to meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ura-ura-ura-uraaah!!
Trainer, take out the guy on the right!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, cleared it!! You've gotten pretty good!
Ha-ha, you were absolute garbage when we started!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—DOUBT!!
Yeeeah, called it~!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah~~ Not again, Pokke-san!
Your gut is way too sharp...!
choice_data_list: (What on earth am I doing with my life...)
(What on earth am I doing with my life...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've spent almost every single day hanging out with them. As a trainer,
I can't help but wonder if this is okay. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's GOOOOO!!
I'm gonna blow right past all of you punks at once!!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa—!
Dang, Pokke-san, you're seriously insane...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was thoroughly captivated by her running. She has immense potential,
adores Fuji Kiseki... If only I could conquer the Derby together with her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While looking for the right opportunity to scout her, unable to find an opening,
one fateful day arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While hanging out with Jungle Pocket and the crew at their spot,
an email arrived on my laptop. It was—the mock race entry list.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Hm? What's up, Trainer?
choice_data_list: The entry list for the upcoming mock race just came in...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh... —Wait!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —I'm runnin' in this!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Look here!! I gotta beat the crap outta this one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The runner she pointed at in the race was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon... Even before making her official debut,
she's already tipped as a monster of a horsegirl destined for G1 glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a recent academy race, she crushed the field by a massive three and a half lengths.
She possesses high-tier talent capable of dominating any track condition or race pace.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: What the heck... Is she some kind of monster...?
choice_data_list: In all honesty, her speed is truly monstrous...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —A monster? Bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If you guys got time, come watch.
I'm gonna take that monster down and show everyone what "the strongest" looks like.
